title: Current developments and future perspectives on the formation of luminescent lanthanide supramolecular self-assembly architectures with a focus on nitrogen-based donor ligands
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00750J, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sandra Fernández-Fariña, Oxana Kotova, Shauna R. Donohoe, Thorfinnur Gunnlaugsson
This review covers luminescent lanthanide assemblies from mono- to poly-metallic systems, showing how ligand design controls structure and luminescence functions for applications from hydrogels to bioimaging and sensing.
